title: Farmers stopped at Punjab-Haryana border en route to Delhi rally against India-U.S. trade deal
summary: Farmers wanted to peacefully go to Delhi and participate in the rally but the BJP-led Haryana government has stopped them by erecting barricades, Sarwarn Singh, a farmer leader, said.
new_headline: Farmers Blocked from Protesting US-India Trade Deal in Delhi
new_summary: Farmer groups attempting to reach a rally against the India-US trade deal face obstacles on the Punjab-Haryana border. They're determined to voice their concerns, but authorities are having other plans. #FarmersProtest #IndiaUSTradeDeal

title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi Protest Outside PM's House Over Paper Leaks
summary: Rahul Gandhi said the protest was to demand accountability for the "brutality" against students.
new_headline: Gandhis Stage Protest Outside PM's House in Scathing Paper Leak Row
new_summary: Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi take to the streets to voice outrage against the alleged paper leak scandal, demanding transparency and action from the government.

title: One Launch A Month Our Next Goal After Vikram-1 Success: Skyroot CEO
summary: In an exclusive interview with NDTV, Pawan Kumar Chandana, CEO of Skyroot Aerospace, spoke about the success of Vikram-1.
new_headline: Skyroot Aims for High Orbit with Ambitious Launch Schedule
new_summary: The Indian private space company Skyroot is planning to launch one mission every month after the successful maiden flight of Vikram-1. CEO Pummada Venkata Patchauri shares their vision for a rapid pace of innovation in the space sector.
